verdict.rationale: pnpm's core product is a CLI that runs entirely on the user's own machines. It ships as a self-contained executable that needs no Node.js, runs on Windows, Linux and macOS, and can install offline from its local store. Its source is published on GitHub. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, first-party docs framing self-hosted or air-gapped deployment, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: It needs no Node.js. pnpm is a self-contained executable
Works everywhere. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
`pnpm i --offline` Install offline from the store only
If true, pnpm will use only packages already available in the store.
